Phosphatidylserine levels in the brain can decline with age, so it is important to supplement daily, helping replenish this nutrient that is naturally found in brain cell membranes, to aid brain function.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
2019 Solgar, Inc.
Solgar since 1947

Non-GMO
